name: com.ilezhnin.gamedev-agent-kit
description: AI agent kit for Unity game development: project contracts (AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, CODE_STYLE.md, DEPENDENCIES.md), the kit's Unity and shared skills including asset sourcing/generation/import, agent roles, permissions, and hooks for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Google Antigravity. Helper scripts and hooks ship as Python 3 (standard library only) so they run on macOS, Linux, and Windows; the PowerShell originals stay as the Codex-on-Windows fallback. The setup window installs the kit files into the project root and keeps them updatable via a hash manifest.
